name: Howard DGA-15 / DGA-11
summary: Large, wood-built 1940s high-wing cabin monoplane that seats a pilot and four; the DGA-15P with a Wasp Junior is a strong bush and cross-country classic.

wings: High-wing monoplane with one strut per side
engines: Large radial engine (Wasp Junior, Jacobs or Whirlwind) under a cowl
fuselage: Deep, wide cabin with large side windows seating five
tail: Large rounded fin and rudder, sometimes with finlets on the tailplane

tellTales: High-wing monoplane with a deep, wide cabin and a big radial engine
Single strut per side and a straight, rounded-tip wing
Fixed tailwheel gear under a bulbous, spacious cabin

confusedWith.howToTell: The Reliant SR-7 and later have a gull wing that dips near the root; the Howard wing is straight and the cabin is deeper and wider.
The Robin has a pair of parallel diagonal bracing struts under each wing; the Howard has a single strut per side.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
